sentences.text: Super realistic masks are made from flexible materials such as silicone and are designed to imitate real human face—down to every last detail.

analysis.translationNatural: 这种足以以假乱真的面具，用硅胶一类软材料做成，连真人脸上的每一点细微之处都照搬不误。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Super realistic masks】 _are made from flexible materials such as silicone_ _and are designed to imitate real human face_(—down to every last detail).

components.part: Super realistic masks

components.part: are made from flexible materials such as silicone
components.note: be made from 强调原材料经加工变化；such as 引出 silicone 作为举例

phrases.usage: 注意区分：be made of（由…制成，看得出原料）/ be made from（由…制成，看不出原料）/ be made in（产地）/ be made to do（被迫做，被动须加 to）/ make sb do（主动使役不带 to）/ make（make-made-made）。

analysis.paragraphRole: 开篇给「超逼真面具」定性：材料柔软、仿真到每一处细节，为下文的辨认实验立起对象。

paragraphs.text: In a study by the Universities of York and Kyoto, researchers asked participants to look at pairs of photographs and decide which showed a 26 face and which showed a person wearing a mask.

sentences.text: In a study by the Universities of York and Kyoto, researchers asked participants to look at pairs of photographs and decide which showed a 26 face and which showed a person wearing a mask.

analysis.translationLiteral: 在约克大学与京都大学的一项研究中，研究者请参与者看成对的照片，并判定哪一张显示的是一张 26 的脸、哪一张显示的是一个戴着面具的人。
analysis.translationNatural: 约克大学和京都大学联合做过一个实验：给受试者看一组组照片，让他们指认哪张是真人、哪张是戴了面具的人。
analysis.structMarkup: (In a study by the Universities of York and Kyoto), 【researchers】 _asked participants to look at pairs of photographs and decide_ {which showed a 26 face and which showed a person wearing a mask}.

components.note: 介词短语点明研究出处，by 引出主持机构，两所大学并列

components.part: researchers
components.note: 复数主语，谓语用过去式 asked

components.part: asked participants to look at pairs of photographs and decide

components.part: which showed a 26 face and which showed a person wearing a mask
components.note: 两个 which 引导的从句并列作 decide 的宾语；26 空落在 a 与 face 之间，必为形容词

phrases.meaning: 看；研究、考察

phrases.meaning: 研究、调查；学习 / 研究、学习
phrases.usage: 注意区分：study（研究，可数）/ research（研究，不可数）。常见搭配：a study on sth / research study。

phrases.usage: 注意区分：universities（复数/三单）/ university（原形）。

pitfalls: look at 在论文语境不是「看一眼」，而是「研究」。
定语从句中关系词已充当成分，从句里不要再重复该代词。
analysis.paragraphRole: 交代实验任务（二选一辨认真脸与面具脸），并借 a 26 face 埋下第 26 空。

paragraphs.text: Surprisingly, participants made the wrong call in one-in-five cases.

sentences.text: Surprisingly, participants made the wrong call in one-in-five cases.

analysis.translationLiteral: 令人惊讶地，参与者在五分之一的案例里做出了错误的判断。
analysis.translationNatural: 结果出人意料：每五次判断里，就有一次看走了眼。

components.part: Surprisingly

components.part: made the wrong call

components.part: in one-in-five cases
components.note: one-in-five 是连字符构成的复合形容词，意为「五分之一的」，说明误判比例

clauses: 本句是简单句，没有从句；主干为「主谓宾 + 评注性状语 + 介词状语」。

phrases.meaning: 令人惊讶的、出人意料的、意外的（surprising 的副词形式）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：surprisingly（副词）/ surprising（原形）。
phrases.example: Surprisingly, participants made the wrong call in one-in-five cases. 结果出人意料：每五次判断里，就有一次看走了眼。

phrases.example: Surprisingly, participants made the wrong call in one-in-five cases. 结果出人意料：每五次判断里，就有一次看走了眼。

phrases.meaning: 称呼（call sb sth）；打电话；呼叫
phrases.usage: 注意区分：call sb sth（称某人某物）/ call sb up（打电话）/ so-called（所谓的）。常见搭配：call for / call on。
phrases.example: This is what we call the third space. 这就是我们所说的「第三空间」。

pitfalls: 注意区分：surprisingly（副词）/ surprising（原形）。
注意区分：be made of（由…制成，看得出原料）/ be made from（由…制成，看不出原料）/ be made in（产地）/ be made to do（被迫做，被动须加 to）/ make sb do（主动使役不带 to）/ make（make-made-made）。
注意区分：call sb sth（称某人某物）/ call sb up（打电话）/ so-called（所谓的）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 抛出核心反常数据「五分之一误判」，为下句点明 20% 错误率蓄势。

paragraphs.text: The 20% error rate 27 in the study likely underestimates the extent to which people would struggle to tell an 28 face from the real thing outside of the lab.

sentences.text: The 20% error rate 27 in the study likely underestimates the extent to which people would struggle to tell an 28 face from the real thing outside of the lab.

analysis.translationLiteral: 这项研究里 27 的 20% 错误率，很可能低估了人们在实验室之外要费多大气力才能把一张 28 的脸与真脸区分开来的程度。
analysis.translationNatural: 研究测到的 20% 误判率恐怕还偏保守：真到了现实场景，人们分辨仿真脸和真脸只会更吃力。
analysis.structMarkup: 【The 20% error rate 27 in the study】 _likely underestimates_ ~the extent to which people would struggle to tell an 28 face from the real thing outside of the lab~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + 过去分词作后置定语 + 定语从句（to which 引导，修饰 extent）

components.part: The 20% error rate 27 in the study
components.note: 核心词是 rate；27 空作后置定语修饰 rate，需过去分词，指「研究中所观测到的」

components.part: likely underestimates
components.note: underestimate 意为「低估」，副词 likely 给判断留出余地、不作绝对断言

components.part: the extent to which people would struggle to tell an 28 face from the real thing outside of the lab
components.note: the extent to which... 是固定框架，介词 to 提前；28 空在 an 与 face 之间，需形容词且以元音音素开头

clauses: 关系词引导定语从句，修饰前面的先行词；从句内部用陈述语序。
本句主干为「主谓宾 + 过去分词作后置定语 + 定语从句（to which 引导，修饰 extent）」，先找限定动词再切分修饰成分。

phrases.meaning: ……的程度
phrases.usage: to which 引导定语从句，正式书面语。
phrases.example: The extent to which it matters is unclear. 它有多重要尚不清楚。

phrases.meaning: 研究、调查；学习 / 研究、学习
phrases.usage: 注意区分：study（研究，可数）/ research（研究，不可数）。常见搭配：a study on sth / research study。
phrases.example: The study tracked 200 teenagers. 这项研究追踪了 200 名青少年。

phrases.meaning: 可能的；很可能（be likely to do）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：likely（可作 adj./adv.）/ probable/possible（只作形容词）。常见搭配：be likely to do / more likely than。

analysis.paragraphRole: 把实验室数据外推到现实、指出问题更严重，同时埋下 27、28 两空。

phrases.meaning: 数据（datum 的复数，现代英语也常作不可数，谓语单复皆可但须一致）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：data（数据）/ date（日期）。常见搭配：data on sth / collect data。
phrases.example: The data show a clear trend. 数据显示出明确的趋势。

phrases.meaning: 差异（difference 的复数）

phrases.example: There are clear differences between the groups. 两组之间有明显差异。

analysis.paragraphRole: 交代取样横跨两国、目的是比较种族差异，并带出第 29 空。

paragraphs.text: There are now dozens of criminal cases in which offenders have 31 themselves off as people of a different age, race or gender, sending police investigations down the wrong path.

sentences.text: There are now dozens of criminal cases in which offenders have 31 themselves off as people of a different age, race or gender, sending police investigations down the wrong path.
